parameters.name: AcceleratorId
parameters.description: The ID of the GA instance.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to **50**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the GA instance is deployed. Set the value to **cn-hangzhou**.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ga list-listeners --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --accelerator-id ga-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --protocol HTTP --region cn-hangzhou
